statements: Add redeem(store, code, userId, orderId, now) to src/coupons.mjs. It records a redemption and returns the coupon's percent.
The coupon rules are in the README. A coupon that cannot be used throws HttpError 422, with code unknown_coupon, coupon_expired, coupon_used_up or coupon_limit_reached.
Everything that exists today keeps working exactly as it does now, apart from what the rules require. The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add coupon redemption, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
